tone.target: bright clean pop-rock with chorus and delay shimmer
tone.profile: bright clean pop-rock with chorus and delay shimmer
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain using a pre-amp boost for clarity, followed by Chorus modulation, leading into the US Deluxe amp model with a clear 2x12 cab. Delay and Plate reverb add necessary space and shimmer.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide clean edge and lift the high end for pop-rock clarity.
blocks.gap: Using Boost to simulate a clean boost pedal effect, as no dedicated transparent pre-amp is available.

alternatives.reason: Compression could also add sustain and polish.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the required stereo chorus effect central to the pop-rock sound.
Keep the tone clean and avoid heavy drive or fuzz.
blocks.gap: The target is purely clean pop-rock; no distortion module is needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a bright, clean Fender-style tone suitable for pop-rock.
Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.
Enhance the bright top end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
blocks.gap: Using Guitar EQ 1 to sculpt the tone for maximum brightness without sounding harsh.

alternatives.reason: Could offer a different frequency curve, but EQ 1 is sufficient.

proposals.reason: Enhance the clean, shimmering pop tone and increase perceived airiness.
